events.label: Sweep best of 6
events.summary: Sweep best of 6: 10.5 ± 2.2 vs 4.2 ± 1.6 for current practice (visits/week by day workers to libraries). SW Sweep best of 6 wins on the target metric: 10.5 ± 2.2 visits/week by day workers, versus 4.2 ± 1.6 for current practice and 9.4 ± 2.3 for the next best tested option (E4). It also held up in held-out tests, reaching 10.625 in A, 8.625 in B, and 8.75 in C, all above E0, E1, and OS. Budget (budget of town-run places (Ely City Hall, Ely Ice Arena, Ely Public Library, Semer's Park, Veterans Memorial Field, Whiteside Park)): $910.6k/yr (+$39.0k vs current; wage $25/h from model default ($25/staff hour incl. benefits)).
events.assumptions: The result depends on synthetic resident schedules, arrival rates, and word-of-mouth rates from the model defaults. It also assumes the coded notice-channel labels are valid as represented in the local simulation, even though only online notice was explicitly evidenced in the local sources.
events.pilot: Run a 6-week pilot of Mon–Fri 09:00-20:30 at Ely Public Library, and measure weekly visits by day workers, door counts by hour, and any overtime or staffing-cost impact versus the current schedule. Compare the pilot period to the same weeks from the prior schedule to check whether the observed gain is close to the predicted lift.
